chain_words.nuance: having enough money to live without worry
having a large amount of money and property
general sense of having much money
having a high level of income and a privileged lifestyle
displaying great wealth in a luxurious way

explanation: These words all describe having money, from being financially comfortable to displaying extravagant luxury.

usage_notes.difference: 'Wealthy' describes owning a lot of money or property; 'affluent' describes a high income and a comfortable, privileged lifestyle.
